test_title: PYST 34: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, G, H, I, J, K, L and M, are sitting in a row, facing north(but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit between M and I. Only K sits to the right of J. Only one person sits between I and J. G sits at some place to the right of L but at some place to the left of H.

How many people sit between H and L?
solution:
Given: Seven people, G, H, I, J, K, L and M, are sitting in a row, facing north(but not necessarily in the same order).

1) Only two people sit between M and I.

2) Only K sits to the right of J. 

3) Only one person sits between I and J.
